strings: m_c has been avoiding sleeping more and more. r_c0 can understand it, but {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject} still {VERB/r_c0/try/tries} to talk with {PRONOUN/m_c/object} about the fears that keep {PRONOUN/m_c/object} awake.
It isn't something that m_c can explain. {PRONOUN/m_c/poss/CAP} avoidance of sleep comes from something deeper within.
As m_c takes yet another night patrol, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates can only take notice of how worn down {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/seem/seems}.
